title: Tenant-safe notification deep links

behavior.sameWorkspaceResolution: Persisted notification links resolve only when they are relative, same-workspace paths under the active tenant base.
behavior.supportedTargets: Content and render records preserve their identifiers; publication, media, billing and policy-review links map to the existing workspace views.
behavior.readThenOpen: Clicking a notification acknowledges it when unread, closes the popover and then opens the resolved in-app destination.
behavior.renderSelection: A render link is resolved through the tenant-scoped render API before the video studio selects the target job.
behavior.failClosed: Absolute, cross-tenant, malformed and unknown links are rejected without arbitrary browser navigation.

localVerification.uiHarness: verify-local --ui-only --ui-spec=notifications.spec.ts failed closed before fixture startup because 127.0.0.1:6379 was occupied; no existing service was contacted.

exactCi.artifactByteInspection: pending exact final run; authenticated artifact downloads may remain unavailable

passedJobs: Native populated upgrade and migration recovery
failedAttempt.reason: The browser regression fixture used /assets while notification event links use /media; the resolver correctly rejected the unsupported path and the assertion timed out.

limits: This increment activates in-app navigation only; it adds no email/SMS/mobile push, durable replay, cross-process fan-out or realtime delivery SLO.
CI verifies owned fixtures and does not deploy.
Production/live-provider, remote durability/RPO-RTO, deployed and full-master acceptance remain open.
